contracts: Exact public-only configuration and prompt hash validated before client construction.
Existing CommandController and RecordingOllamaClient reused unchanged by this owner.
Each native request event is synchronously flushed and fsynced before transport.
No response repair, retry or fallback; response cap/deadline/error/interruption preserve controller and model attempts.
Exact sequenced parent call/reply protocol; malformed or missing reply fails.
Fresh preflight/postflight identity required for terminated result.
Counter labels recorded native request attempts, not confirmed server inference.
Worker result persisted before terminal delivery; failed terminal send saves delivery-error.json and raises.
Parent owns hard process deadline, actual world and native audit; worker owns no verdict.
limitations: Ordinary development tests, not comparative clinical benefit or formal red team.
Files cannot guarantee persistence after catastrophic filesystem failure; parent must account missing worker receipts and inspect journals.
